trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, central V-shaped depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 140 to 150 degrees; the depth of the notch is shallow relative to the overall horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a continuous, irregular serration pattern consisting of high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys; the left lobe trailing edge is obscured by high-intensity water spray/splash pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible portions of the trailing edges follow a generally convex mathematical curve extending from the median notch toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groupings (approximately 5-10 visible units) concentrated at the distal tip and along the outer margin of the right lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of high-contrast, textured bio-fouling or calcareous-like deposits localized on the terminal tip of the right fluke lobe, resulting in an irregular, thickened edge geometry.
